about: The Workbench icons of the Descent drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is D1X-Rebirth's own program icon (d1x-rebirth/d1x-rebirth.png). Descent-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Descent.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Descent.info.
